title: polypodium virginianum f. biserratum
intro: Polypodium virginianum f. biserratum, commonly known as Southern polypody, is a species of fern found in North America. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium virginianum f. biserratum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
